entities.summary: Manfred von Knobelsdorff, Lieutenant Colonel Waffen-SS, oversaw much of Wewelsburg Castle from February 12, 1935, through January 24, 1938, where he presided over several ceremonies. In 1938 Siegfried Taubert succeeded Knobelsdorff.
